#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add the sanitized "token generated" screenshot as ภาพที่ 3ก right after ภาพที่ 3 (PAT setup). Owner: yolo3.
Run only after redact_pat_stdin.py has written images/lab3_hub_05_pat_generated{,_crop}.png. Needs DOCKER_USER
(or private/hub_user) for build_readme.py. Steps, each idempotent:
  1. validate both PNGs (size, opaque #202020 token box, crop == box of full)
  2. README.tmpl.md: {{fig:hub_pat_generated}} after {{fig:hub_pat}}
  3. build_readme.py: FIG entry + SUB label 'ก' (no counter increment, so ภาพที่ 1–27 keep their numbers)
  4. integrate.py: keep the two new images (otherwise a rerun would archive them)
  5. verify_readme.py: extra checks for 3ก (existing checks untouched)
  6. rebuild README.md; it must equal the old README plus exactly the new figure block, else the old README is restored
  7. run verify_readme.py and secret_scan.py
Does not touch code blocks, the Jenkinsfile or any other image."""
import os, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
from PIL import Image
W = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
S = W / 'scripts'
LAB = W.parent.parent / '003_LAB_Docker_Build_Push'
IMG = LAB / 'images'
FULL, CROPF = 'lab3_hub_05_pat_generated.png', 'lab3_hub_05_pat_generated_crop.png'
SIZE, BOX, CROP, FILL = (3440, 1249), (1050, 595, 1400, 646), (1020, 100, 1760, 750), (0x20, 0x20, 0x20)
ALT = 'หน้า Docker Hub หลังกด Generate โดย token ถูกปิดทึบ'
CAP = ('หน้าจริงหลังกด **Generate** · ปิดทับ token ทั้งหมดด้วยแถบทึบ · ภาพตัวอย่างนี้เป็น token สิทธิ์ **Repo Public Read-only** '
       'ซึ่ง push ไม่ได้ ใน LAB นี้ต้องเลือก **Repo Read & Write** ในหน้าตั้งค่า (ภาพที่ 3)')

def patch(path, old, new, done):
    s = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    if done in s: print('already', path.name); return
    assert s.count(old) == 1, f'{path.name}: anchor not unique/found: {old[:60]!r}'
    path.write_text(s.replace(old, new), encoding='utf-8'); print('patched', path.name)

# 1. sanitized files
for f in (FULL, CROPF):
    assert (IMG / f).exists(), f'missing images/{f} - run redact_pat_stdin.py first'
full, crop = Image.open(IMG / FULL), Image.open(IMG / CROPF)
assert full.format == crop.format == 'PNG' and full.size == SIZE, (full.format, crop.format, full.size)
full, crop = full.convert('RGB'), crop.convert('RGB')
assert full.crop(BOX).tobytes() == Image.new('RGB', (BOX[2] - BOX[0], BOX[3] - BOX[1]), FILL).tobytes(), 'token box not opaque #202020'
assert crop.tobytes() == full.crop(CROP).tobytes(), 'crop is not the sanitized box'

# 2. template
patch(W / 'README.tmpl.md', '{{fig:hub_pat}}\n', '{{fig:hub_pat}}\n\n{{fig:hub_pat_generated}}\n', '{{fig:hub_pat_generated}}')

# 3. generator
B = S / 'build_readme.py'
patch(B, "    'github_source': (",
      f"    'hub_pat_generated': ('{CROPF}', '{FULL}', '{ALT}',\n        '{CAP}'),\n    'github_source': (",
      "'hub_pat_generated'")
patch(B, "t = (W / 'README.tmpl.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')\nnum = [0]\n",
      "SUB = {'hub_pat_generated': 'ก'}   # extra figure under the previous number, so ภาพที่ 1–27 keep their numbers\n"
      "t = (W / 'README.tmpl.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')\nnum = [0]\n", 'SUB = {')
patch(B, "    num[0] += 1\n    pic = ", "    if m.group(1) in SUB: label = f'{num[0]}{SUB[m.group(1)]}'\n"
      "    else: num[0] += 1; label = num[0]\n    pic = ", 'label = num[0]')
patch(B, "*ภาพที่ {num[0]} {cap}*", "*ภาพที่ {label} {cap}*", '*ภาพที่ {label} {cap}*')

# 4. keep the new images when integrate.py is rerun
patch(S / 'integrate.py', "'lab3_hub_04_pat_setup_crop.png'}",
      f"'lab3_hub_04_pat_setup_crop.png',\n        '{FULL}', '{CROPF}'}}", f"'{CROPF}'}}")

# 5. verifier: add checks only
patch(S / 'verify_readme.py', "print('README lines', len(r.splitlines())",
      "# 9. PAT result figure: 3ก directly after ภาพที่ 3, crop linked to full, token box opaque, crop taken from sanitized full\n"
      "check('ภาพที่ 3ก (PAT generated) directly after ภาพที่ 3', re.search(r'^\\*ภาพที่ 3 [^\\n]*\\*\\n\\n\\[!\\[[^\\]]*\\]"
      f"\\(\\./images/{re.escape(CROPF)}\\)\\]\\(\\./images/{re.escape(FULL)}\\)\\n\\n\\*ภาพที่ 3ก ', r, re.M))\n"
      "check('3ก is the only sub-numbered figure', re.findall(r'^\\*ภาพที่ (\\d+[^\\d\\s]+) ', r, re.M) == ['3ก'])\n"
      f"pf, pc = Image.open(LAB / 'images' / '{FULL}').convert('RGB'), Image.open(LAB / 'images' / '{CROPF}').convert('RGB')\n"
      f"check('PAT token box opaque #202020', pf.size == {SIZE} and pf.crop({BOX}).tobytes() == Image.new('RGB', "
      f"({BOX[2] - BOX[0]}, {BOX[3] - BOX[1]}), {FILL}).tobytes())\n"
      f"check('PAT crop is a pure crop of the sanitized full', pc.tobytes() == pf.crop({CROP}).tobytes())\n"
      "print('README lines', len(r.splitlines())", "# 9. PAT result figure")

# 6. rebuild and prove the only README change is the new figure
R = LAB / 'README.md'
old = R.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
block = f'[![{ALT}](./images/{CROPF})](./images/{FULL})\n\n*ภาพที่ 3ก {CAP}*\n\n'
if block not in old:
    m = re.search(r'^\*ภาพที่ 3 [^\n]*\*\n\n', old, re.M)
    assert m, 'ภาพที่ 3 caption not found in README.md'
    expected = old[:m.end()] + block + old[m.end():]
else:
    expected = old
env = dict(os.environ)
if not env.get('DOCKER_USER') and not (W / 'private' / 'hub_user').exists():
    sys.exit('set DOCKER_USER (Docker Hub account used in out/) before running')
rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(B)], env=env).returncode
new = R.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if rc or new != expected:
    R.write_text(old, encoding='utf-8')
    sys.exit(f'build_readme rc={rc}, output != old README + figure 3ก; README.md restored')
print('README.md: inserted ภาพที่ 3ก only' if new != old else 'README.md already contains ภาพที่ 3ก')

# 7. verify
rc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(S / 'verify_readme.py')]).returncode
rc |= subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(S / 'secret_scan.py')]).returncode
sys.exit(rc)
